title: Collaborative Participatory Research with LLM agents in South Asia: An Empirically-Grounded Methodological Initiative and Agenda from Field Evidence in Sri Lankan

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative evaluation of translation accuracy for domain-specific, code-mixed terminology in a low-resource language (Sinhala) compared to standard multilingual models, alongside qualitative assessments of cross-lingual communication improvements during field research.

Qualitative evaluation through field observations and participatory workshops to assess the multi-agent system's ability to appropriately navigate local customs, social hierarchies, and culturally specific honorifics.
